title: Lena and the Ledger
author: August Ashgrove
blurb: Petra Halloran, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
